channel.title: Steve Kim — Clinical AI Build Log
channel.description: Why clinical AI fails at the bedside. 20 years as the end user.

item.title: The Best Clinical AI PM Was Never a PM
item.description: A hackathon's top prize went to a lawyer. Bronze went to a cardiologist. The pattern isn't "no coders won" — it's that owning the problem beats knowing the syntax.

item.title: The Correct Calculator Nobody Used
item.description: I built a dose calculator that was right about everything except the one thing that mattered — whether anyone would change how they worked to use it.

item.title: The Hospital Has No Harness
item.description: Software took four years to learn that when the agent fails, you fix the environment, not the model. Clinical AI is still on step one — I know, because I taught the class.
